SOURCE: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/advisor-tool
CACHED: 2026-09-29 (FIRST AUDIT — never covered by this monitor before)

LITERAL FACTS:
- Tool type string: "advisor_20260301"  name: "advisor". Server-side tool.
- Required params: type, name, model (advisor model id). Optional: max_uses (default
  UNLIMITED), max_tokens (min 1024), caching {"type":"ephemeral","ttl":"5m"|"1h"}.
  Also accepts cache_control, allowed_callers, defer_loading, strict.
- Flow: executor emits server_tool_use {name:"advisor", input:{}} -> Anthropic runs a
  SEPARATE SERVER-SIDE INFERENCE PASS on the advisor model -> advisor_tool_result block.
- *** The advisor "receives the executor's full transcript as quoted context in its input.
  That transcript includes your system prompt, the tool definitions, the prior turns and
  tool results, and the text the executor has produced so far in this turn." ***
- "The server_tool_use.input is always empty. The server constructs the advisor's view from
  the full transcript automatically. Nothing the executor puts in input reaches the advisor."
- Advisor runs WITHOUT tools and WITHOUT context management. Its thinking blocks are dropped.
- Result variants (discriminated union on advisor_tool_result.content):
    advisor_result           -> text, stop_reason        (e.g. Claude Opus 4.8 advisor)
    advisor_redacted_result  -> encrypted_content, stop_reason
  *** Sonnet 5.5, Fable 5.1, Mythos 5.1, Opus 5.5, Opus 5, Fable 5, Mythos 5 advisors
  return the ENCRYPTED variant. Those models as EXECUTORS pair ONLY with advisors that
  return the encrypted form => "on those executors the advice text isn't readable in the
  response." Customer-opaque model-to-model channel. ***
- Errors: advisor_tool_result_error, error_code "max_uses_exceeded".
- Model compatibility: advisor must be Sonnet 4.6 or more capable AND at least as capable as
  the executor. Invalid pair -> 400 invalid_request_error.
- Platform availability: BETA on the Claude API and Claude Platform on AWS. NOT on Amazon
  Bedrock, Google Cloud, or Microsoft Foundry.
- Claude Managed Agents variant: configured as part of the AGENT, not as a tool definition —
  add {"type":"advisor","model":...} to the agent's MULTIAGENT ROSTER. No max_uses/max_tokens/
  caching there. Advice delivered as THREAD EVENTS on the session event stream, NOT as
  advisor_tool_result blocks.
- Composes with other tools in the same tools array (doc example pairs it with web_search
  and a client-side run_bash tool).
- Sonnet 5.5 release note (2026-09-28): "The advisor tool rejects Claude Opus 4.8,
  Claude Opus 4.7, and Claude Sonnet 5 as advisors."
- Doc page headings (for future diffing): When to use it / Quick start / How it works /
  Tool parameters / Response structure (Successful advisor call, Result variants, Error
  results) / Multi-turn conversations (Resuming a paused turn, Mid-conversation nudge) /
  Streaming / Usage and billing / Advisor prompt caching (Executor-side, Advisor-side) /
  Combining with other tools / Best practices / Model compatibility (+ Platform
  availability) / Advisor on Claude Managed Agents / Next steps.
